description: Permissive footpaths is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Devon County Council. Contains linear records of permissive paths in Devon. It only includes paths where there is a formal agreement with Devon County Council. Coverage: Devon County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Devon County Council. The portal shows 2016-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
